text_block_list.text: (Screeech!)

After discussing it with Manhattan Cafe, 
our overseas expedition――entering the 
French GⅠ―― was officially decided.

Today, Manhattan Cafe departs from this 
airport. Agnes Tachyon and I will 
accompany her, and the three of us will 
take on this challenge together.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer. Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In order to catch up with my "friend" 
beyond the sky...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, now, hold your horses.

Agnes Tachyon shrugged and came to a 
sudden halt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's review this away trip one last time. 
We might have overlooked some requirement. 
Now then—

She began speaking as if she had some 
ulterior motive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The umamusume "Manhattan Cafe". Her talent 
hardly needs mentioning at this point.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Capable of reaching unprecedented heights. 
However—her hooves are far from sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Running on domestic tracks is fine. But 
it's not suited for overseas turf where 
high power is demanded.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the change in environment 
and the long journey. These two 
unfavorable conditions could trigger a 
recurrence of her sudden weight 
fluctuations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Those are the conditions. Now, taking all 
of this into account—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san, what are you saying...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Not after all this time... I didn't mean 
anything like that at all..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hold your tongue. I never said you were 
the one I was debating, did I?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, why don't we have a chat? Before 
you happily pound the French turf, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An overseas G1. If you're truly determined 
to challenge it, I'll accompany you. Don't 
worry, if you're serious, we'll find a way 
to make it work.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if it ends in failure, 
this is merely an experiment to me. It is 
of no consequence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what about you—or rather, the lot 
of you? This journey is almost entirely 
irreversible, you know."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If she fails, Cafe's racing career is 
over. Is it really worth the risk?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Personal feelings aside, what is your 
judgment as a Trainer? I haven't heard 
that part yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This is... just a final reminder. A 
simple memo, devoid of emotion."

Even as she said that, I thought I saw a 
subtle flicker deep within Agnes Tachyon's 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Tell me, Trainer. What is your... 'top 
priority'?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"An experiment requires definitions. Allow 
me to lay down the litmus paper."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What do you—desire?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to tell me. Just look 
toward yourself, and toward Cafe's 
futureâ

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What takes priority—declare it.
It felt like... a rather cold lifeline.

'Top priority'... That was the promise 
once made with Manhattan Cafe...

"Catch up to my friend, and overtake 
them."

If things continue like this, Manhattan 
Cafe and I will end up martyring ourselves 
to that dream...

Even if it doesn't come true, as long as I 
can be by their side until the end, that's 
all I could ask for... But.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san... Thank... you so much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you can help me whenever something 
happens... Even if I have to fudge it a 
bit, I'm sure I'll manage somehow...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, right now, there is a box of 
chocolates right before your eyes."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I do have one. A proper one. A handmade 
one...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please don't fool around... I worked 
really hard to make this...

Everything that has been built up. What if 
all of it was meant "for the end"?

What if, for the sake of her dream, 
Manhattan Cafe had to lose everything 
else?

"Even so... even so, with Manhattan 
Cafe... going overseas..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is our "top priority"—?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san?
choice_data_list:
The cafe's success and survival are more 
important than my dream

The cafe's success and survival are more 
important than my dream, you know

text_block_list.text:
...Only after saying it aloud did I think, 
'Ah, so that's how it is.'

My first dream changed. Somewhere along 
the way, it drifted just a little.

At this crossroads, I could no longer... 
pretend that it didn't matter to me. And 
then—

Along with that resignation, my sound 
judgment as a Trainer returned.
choice_data_list: Let's call off the overseas campaign...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Well then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is goodbye, then.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is goodbye. I thought you... were 
different. Because you promised we'd 
overtake them together.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it was a misunderstanding... 
Just me... being selfish...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... problem. From here on... even by 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... problem. I just have to get back to 
where I was...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I will catch up to 'my friend', no matter 
what. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Goodbye.

Blood oozes from Manhattan Cafe's 
toenails, and blood also seeps from the 
nails of the hand she begins to reach out.

I wonder if I should stop her, even by 
force. As I gaze at the back of the 
departing Manhattan Cafe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They won't move... My legs... just 
won't...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Why? I have to... go...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If I don't go, my "friend" will...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Friend" is... fading away...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Even so...!!
( R O O O O A A R ! )

A voice resembling a death cry shot 
through her brain. The voice of what 
mattered most to Manhattan Cafe. Even 
so...

Manhattan Cafe couldn't move from the 
spot. As if her very soul had been pulled 
out of her...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It can't... be helped, can it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's... nothing I can do... Trainer, 
Tachyon... Two against one is just...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but what... What am I supposed 
to do from now on...?”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu... uuu...

I stepped beside Manhattan Cafe, and Agnes 
Tachyon followed suit. And thus――

Manhattan Cafe's overseas expedition was 
called off at the last minute. We decided 
to return to our next domestic goal, the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
